seo_title: Ghame Professional: Bulk Spices for Hotels, Restaurants and Caterers

export.heading: Sri Lankan Flavour. Ready for the World.
export.text: Ghame supplies food manufacturers, distributors and retailers in Sri Lanka and abroad. Our factory's food safety system is certified to ISO 22000:2018, HACCP and GMP, and samples of every product are tested at an accredited laboratory. Tell us your market, products and volumes and we will reply with what we can supply.
